title: Fill any form in one click
caption: Realistic names, addresses, unique emails and Stripe test cards go into every field, including selects and radios.

title: From empty form to done
caption: Open a sign-up or checkout page, click Fill or press Ctrl+Shift+F, and you are ready to submit.

title: Auto-fill your test site on load
caption: Switch it on for a site in the popup and every page load is filled for you, with a toast that shows how to undo.

title: Keep, change or skip each field
caption: The side panel lists every field so you can lock values and only change the email on each run.

title: Rich-text editors and payments too
caption: Card fields get valid test cards with a future expiry, and rich-text editors get real paragraphs.

title: Settings that fit your workflow
caption: Manage auto-fill sites, test data, personas, URL rules and Gemini AI, then export them for your team.
